_howto: This file drives parkatlas.io/gear. Edit it, then run `node web/build-gear.mjs` (or `npm run web:build`) and push.
tag: your Amazon Associates tracking ID. Used for any item that has `asin` or `search` instead of a full `url`.
Per item, give ONE of: `url` (a pasted amzn.to SiteStripe link — preferred, used as-is), `asin` (10-char product code), or `search` keywords.
pick: true adds the personal badge. image: optional URL for your own product photo. enabled: false hides an item or section without deleting it.

hero.title: Gear worth bringing along.
hero.lede: Things I use, recommend, or would genuinely pack for a park trip. Nothing here is filler.

trust: I only include gear I use myself, have researched, or would genuinely recommend for a park trip.
disclosure: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.

sections.title: What I actually use
sections.blurb: The short list. If I'm heading out for a weekend, these are already in the car.

items.name: Black Diamond daypack
items.why: My everyday pack. Sits close, carries a full day of water and layers, and doesn't look like luggage in town.

items.name: Anker portable charger
items.why: Enough juice for a weekend of photos and offline maps. Lives in the pack's top pocket.

items.name: YETI Rambler bottle
items.why: Ice at the trailhead is still ice back at the car.

items.name: Salomon Speedcross trail runners
items.why: Grippy on slickrock and mud, light enough to forget about. I hike in these more than boots.

items.name: Outdoor Research Echo sun hoodie
items.why: Sun protection without the sunscreen-on-your-arms routine. Dries in minutes.

items.name: Darn Tough ultralight socks
items.why: No blisters, no smell, and a lifetime guarantee they actually honor.

sections.title: Day hiking essentials
sections.blurb: The stuff that makes a five-mile loop pleasant instead of a slog.

items.name: Black Diamond daypack
items.why: Room for water, layers, snacks, and a first aid kit — nothing more.

items.name: Anker portable charger
items.why: Offline maps and photos eat batteries faster than you'd think.

items.name: Black Diamond trekking poles
items.why: Knees on the descent will thank you. These collapse small enough for a carry-on.

items.name: Black Diamond rechargeable headlamp
items.why: Sunrise hikes and late finishes. Never rely on your phone flashlight.

items.name: LMNT electrolytes
items.why: Water alone isn't enough on a hot day. One packet per bottle.

items.name: EVERLIT mini first aid kit
items.why: Blister care and tweezers get used more than anything else.

items.name: Sun Bum sunscreen
items.why: High elevation sun is not the sun you're used to. Reapply at lunch.

items.name: Marmot PreCip rain shell
items.why: Afternoon thunderstorms are a feature of the mountain West, not a bug.

items.name: prAna Halle hiking pants
items.why: Stretchy, tough, and they don't look like hiking pants at dinner.

sections.title: National park road trip gear
sections.blurb: Parks are far apart. The drive is part of the trip — make the car work for you.

items.name: YETI Tundra 45 cooler
items.why: Holds ice for days between towns with grocery stores.

items.name: Syncwire MagSafe phone mount
items.why: Snap the phone on, navigate hands-free, snap it off at the trailhead.

items.name: WeatherTech windshield sunshade
items.why: Desert parking lots are brutal. The car is bearable when you get back.

sections.title: Camping favorites
sections.blurb: Car-camping comfort, and a coffee setup I'll admit is a little serious.

items.name: KEIWRLIGHT lantern + string lights
items.why: Lantern for the table, 30 feet of string lights for the tent. One battery, USB-C.

items.name: Klymit insulated sleeping pad
items.why: The single biggest upgrade to sleeping outside.

items.name: Kelty Deluxe Lounge chair
items.why: Wide, low, two cupholders. The chair everyone else ends up sitting in.

items.name: Jetboil Stash
items.why: Boils water for coffee in about two minutes and nests into itself. Morning solved.

items.name: YETI stackable mugs
items.why: Coffee stays hot through a slow sunrise. They stack, so two take the space of one.

items.name: Comandante hand grinder
items.why: Pricey, I know. I travel with a coffee nerd, and this is the one thing that's non-negotiable.

items.name: AeroPress
items.why: Genuinely good coffee, nothing to break, rinses clean in seconds.

items.name: Coleman 2-in-1 grill & stove
items.why: Grill on one side, burner on the other. Dinner for a group without hauling the kitchen.

sections.title: Cold weather
sections.blurb: Sunrise at 9,000 feet is cold in July. These are the layers that make it fine.

items.name: Smartwool merino gloves
items.why: Warm, thin, and touchscreen-friendly so the photos still happen.

items.name: Smartwool Smartloft vest
items.why: Core warmth without the arm bulk. Lives in the car from October to May.

items.name: Smartwool merino base layer top
items.why: Wear it three days; nobody will know.

items.name: Smartwool merino base layer bottoms
items.why: Under hiking pants on cold mornings, as pajamas at camp.

items.name: Smartwool light cushion socks
items.why: Warm feet change your whole mood. These do it without bulk in the boot.

items.name: Turtle Fur beanie
items.why: Soft, fleece-lined, and it stays put in wind.
